answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a long technical clauses, numbers at the end register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the summit of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A terrace of per-task receipts records who did what, and the horizon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution before the ledger credits work.
